The '''Twelve-and-Under Tournament''' was a [[push-feather]] competition for [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] twelve and under in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] won this tournament when he was nine [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.
